# What the chat can do in ADCode

<!-- Generated by apps/desktop/src/main/chatParity.ts. Do not edit by hand: run
     ADCODE_WRITE_PARITY=1 npx vitest run apps/desktop/test/chatParity.test.ts -->

Every feature in the catalogue (`packages/help`), and how the in-app chat reaches it. The chat
finds features with `adcode_features`, runs their commands and changes their settings with
`adcode_action`, and has dedicated tools where a feature needs more than a button.

- 177 features: 26 with a dedicated tool, 139 through `adcode_action`, 10 only after the person confirms, 1 refused by design, 1 with nothing to run (explained by `adcode_features`).
- Every command the window registers belongs to a feature (`featureCommandCoverage.test.ts`), so every command except `ai.fullAccess` and `app.quit` is runnable.
- Guarded settings (ads, updates, edit approval, Full access, connector approvals, AI file tools, custom endpoint, provider, connections, agent profiles, language servers) and every text setting ask in the app's dialog first. Full access is refused outright.
- Every change the chat makes through these tools is written to the debug log.

## Actions that take an argument or give an answer

| `adcode_action` | What it does | Confirmed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command: workspace.openRecentAt`, `arg` | Runs it with a folder path | No - opens a view |
| `command: agents.editAgent`, `arg` | Runs it with an agent id | No - opens a view |
| `command: community.remixFeature`, `arg` | Runs it with a feature id | No - opens a view |
| `app: projects` | Lists folders open in a window and recent folders | Read only |
| `app: earnings` | Reads ad earnings, AI credits and what can be converted | Read only |
| `app: convert_earnings`, `amount` | Converts that many dollars of earnings to AI credits | Yes, with both balances before and after |

## Remaining gaps

| Gap | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Full access mode | By design. The setting and its warning card are refused, so the assistant can never remove its own guard rails. |
| Withdrawing earnings | By design. Payouts happen on the website; the chat can open the page (`ads.withdrawEarnings`) and nothing more. |
| Buying credits or changing plan | By design. The chat opens the pages (`ai.buyTokens`, `ai.upgradePlan`); paying is the person's. |
| Signing in, API keys, connector sign-ins | By design. Credentials are typed by the person (`account.open`, `ai.connect`). |
| Ads, updates, edit approval, provider and connections | Guarded settings: the chat can change them only after the person confirms in a dialog. |
| Reading usage numbers | Not built. The chat opens the usage views (`ai.showUsage`, `ai.chatUsage`) but cannot read the figures back. |
| Deleting a task agent | Not built as an action. `create_agent` creates and updates; removing one is done on the Agents board (or as a confirmed raw edit of the guarded setting). |
| Results of window commands | The window runs a command without answering, so for commands that open a view the chat knows it was sent, not what the view shows. |
| Starting a live room or joining one | Started by the person: invite codes and who joins are theirs to decide. |
| Editor gestures (multi-cursor, selections, go to definition) | Commands exist and run in the focused editor, but they act on the person's cursor; the chat edits files with its own tools instead. |

| Use a coding CLI as your model | `ai.codingCli` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `ai.useCodingCli` |
| Free AI in a minute | `ai.freeKey` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `ai.getFreeKey` |
| New project from an idea | `workbench.newProject` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `workspace.newProject` |
| Welcome: what do you want to build? | `workbench.welcome` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `onboarding.open` |
| Chat history and memory | `ai.sessions` | dedicated tool | `adcode_chats` reads and searches past conversations. Also adcode_action: commands `ai.toggle`, `ai.newConversation` |
| Open IDE in a separate window | `workbench.openIde` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `workspace.openIde` |
| A project in each window | `workbench.projectWindows` | dedicated tool | `adcode_action` app: projects lists open and recent folders; `workspace.openRecentAt` (arg: path) opens one, in a new window when a project is open. Also adcode_action: commands `workspace.newWindow`, `workspace.openRecentNewWindow` |
| ADCode on the web | `workbench.webVersion` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `help.openWebVersion` |
| Report a problem with a debug log | `workbench.debugLog` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `help.report`, `help.copyDebugLog`, `help.saveDebugLog` |
| Open source licences | `workbench.openSource` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `help.openSourceLicences` |
| Vibe sidebar | `workbench.vibeSidebar` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `workspace.vibeSidebar` |
| Changes panel | `workbench.changes` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `workspace.changes` |
| Agents board | `workbench.agentsBoard` | dedicated tool | `create_agent` and `delegate_task`; `agents.newTask`, `agents.editAgent` (arg: agent id) open the board. Also adcode_action: commands `agents.open`, `agents.newTask` |
| Tools page | `workbench.toolsPage` | dedicated tool | `adcode_connectors`: list, add (preset or custom), connect, enable tools, disconnect, remove (confirmed). Also adcode_action: commands `tools.open`, `tools.addServer`, `tools.servers`, `tools.skills` |
| Agent flow | `workbench.agentFlow` | dedicated tool | `manage_agent_flow`: create, edit, rename, delete, turn on or off for all or chosen chats, share, import. Every change is confirmed. Also adcode_action: commands `agents.flow`; after confirming: `adcode.ai.agentFlows` |
| Mods | `workbench.mods` | dedicated tool | `customize_adcode`: apply or adjust a mod (confirmed), list, on, off, remove (confirmed). Also adcode_action: commands `mods.open` |
| Solo and Team | `workbench.soloTeam` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `collab.teamArea`, `collab.soloArea` |
| Sort and pin conversations | `ai.sortConversations` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `chat.sortConversations` |
| Floating panels | `workbench.floatingPanels` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `view.resetFloatingPanels` |
| Connect your apps (Gmail, Supabase, Cloudflare and more) | `community.apps` | dedicated tool | `adcode_connectors` adds and connects them; signing in to the app stays with the person. Also adcode_action: commands `community.apps` |
| A live room's shared context and chat | `community.roomContext` | dedicated tool | `adcode_room`: read, say, note, shared plan. Also adcode_action: commands `collab.liveRoom`; settings `adcode.collab.chatNotify` |
| Plugins | `community.plugins` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `community.plugins`, `community.installed` |
| Add-ons | `community.addons` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `community.addons` |
| Plugin Studio | `community.studio` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `community.studio`, `community.remixFeature` (arg: a feature id) |
| Artifacts | `community.artifacts` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `community.artifacts`, `community.shareProject`, `community.inbox` |
| Creator profile | `community.profile` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `community.you` |
| Sell your plugins (coming soon) | `community.monetize` | adcode_action | adcode_action: commands `community.monetize` |
